definitions.explanation: The black-colored belt worn by advanced practitioners of martial arts such as judo, karate, and kendo. Also used figuratively to describe someone who is highly skilled in a particular area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黒帯|くろおび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I have a black belt in judo.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{黒帯|くろおび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: It took ten years to finally earn my black belt.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空手|からて}→空手：04454_karate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黒帯|くろおび}で、⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{怖|こわ}がられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Our department head holds a black belt in karate and is feared within the company.

notes:
In Japanese martial arts, belt colors indicate rank. {白帯|しろおび} (white belt) is for beginners, and {黒帯|くろおび} signifies advanced level.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒帯|くろおび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to earn a black belt)
- {黒帯|くろおび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to hold a black belt)
- {黒帯|くろおび}⟦{保持者|ほじしゃ}→保持者：28959_hojisha⟧ (black belt holder)

USAGE:
Can be used figuratively: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黒帯|くろおび}だ (He's a black belt in negotiation). This figurative use conveys expert-level mastery.
